name: Harusame Youbi
source:
The game is set in a Japanese onsen-ryoukan (hot spring inn). The player character is working for three weeks in the inn, which belongs to his auntie. There you meet several girls, workers or customers at the inn. Some of the stories involve Japanese mysticism and supernatural elements.

[Taken from [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/dreamcast/579003-harusame-youbi/reviews/review-24170]an old review by Tarot[/url]]
translation:
遊戲舞臺是日本的一家溫泉旅館。玩家扮演的角色將在這家阿姨經營的旅館工作三週，並在那裡結識幾名女性，包括旅館員工和住客。部分故事還涉及日本神秘主義與超自然元素。

[摘自[url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/dreamcast/579003-harusame-youbi/reviews/review-24170]Tarot早年的評論[/url]]
